### Function Rules

- Max 14 lines per function
- One clear task per function
- No nested functions
- Split complex logic into helpers
- Arrow functions (except constructors/event handlers)
- Proper TypeScript types

### JSDoc Convention

```typescript
/**
 * @fileoverview [Title]
 * @description [Details]
 * @module [path]
 */

/**
 * Method description
 * @param name - Description
 * @returns Description
 */
```
